challenged_statement: A universal bound on the density of an indefinite rank-three quadratic pushforward follows from only a universal L-infinity bound on the three-dimensional input density.
counterexample: For R>1, delta=1/(pi R), take rho=1 on E_R={R<=z<=2R, 0<=r^2-z^2<=delta} in cylindrical coordinates. E_R has volume one, so ||rho||_infinity=1. For q=r^2-z^2, p_q(u)=pi R on 0<u<delta, hence ||p_q||_infinity=pi R->infinity.
scope: Refutes the L-infinity-only coarea bridge, not the full QFORM conjecture. The constructed 3D density is not claimed to be a projection of an admissible product source.
replacement_requirement: Retain product/projection provenance jointly with rank-three curvature; do not use only a pointwise conditional density cap or an L-infinity-only coarea lemma.
